how: Confirmatory family: 15m, range gate, tagged, sides pooled, 3 sessions x 3 k = 9 cells, Holm m = 9; net = gross - 0.14 %, day-clustered 95 % CI; fills 59-74 % of tagged signals.
window: DEV 2022-01-01..2024-06-30 BTCUSDT futures 1m; VALIDATION not read (no DEV survivor); HOLDOUT never loaded

verdict.label: INCONCLUSIVE (underpowered), not FAIL: prereg_gate BLOCKs all 9 family cells (BLOCKED.md: 146-186 days per cell against 478-1783 needed), so no FAIL is available. 0 of 9 cells survive (dev_survivors.json is []); every cell has net below zero (-0.07 to -0.20 % per trade) and none has a Holm p below 0.17.

why: Every cell has net below zero (-0.07 to -0.20 % per trade), none a Holm p below 0.17: london k 1.0 n 186 net -0.201 % [-0.369, -0.033]; ny k 1.0 n 233 net -0.073 % [-0.253, +0.108]; asia k 0.25 n 225 net -0.094 % [-0.240, +0.052].

The earlier FAIL was partly an encoding failure (its retest filled 99.9 %, the next open). This arm is a valid return-to-the-band entry (fills 63 / 66 / 68 % at k 0.25 / 0.5 / 1.0) and gives the same sign and size: gross about +0.03 %, net negative.
The session-range tag (OURS) and the range gate do nothing measurable (t between -0.7 and 0.8). CIs are about +-0.15 %, so a gross edge of 0.12-0.15 % per trade is NOT excluded: not a disproof.
